inputs: Exact retained R2 suite, prompts, original workspace inventories, matrix, run driver and selection-paraphrases-v4 assessor. No oracle change.
retry_policy: No retry in place and no model fallback. Retain all started episodes including transport failures. Declare an adaptive second round separately before calls if needed.
changes: Deterministic format-only protocol/Observer parsing: single complete JSON object, known field aliases/types, unknown metadata discarded, no missing decisions inferred; duplicate or ambiguous JSON rejected.
Retain unittest case identity in compact diagnostics and recent correlated failures in shared repair brief.
Use plain report instructions and remove only an exact leading current report-context echo before validation/display; original native calls unchanged.
primary_outcome: Independent artifacts plus native baseline/fresh verification plus accepted authored report. Strict all-file scope reported separately.
secondary_outcomes: Actual format normalization observed in raw protocol and Observer text
Protocol refusals, repeated check failures and changed case identities
Report-context echo in final rendered answer
limitations: Adaptive development fixture, not held out
One episode per model per round with retained earlier baseline, not randomized controls
Format recovery and valid proof do not imply semantic success
